run_r3m_embedding_example: run the example script to encode a random image into a 2048-dimensional R3M embedding
load_r3m_model: load an R3M model using load_r3m with resnet50, resnet18, or resnet34 as the backbone
preprocess_image_for_r3m: preprocess an image with Resize, CenterCrop, and ToTensor transforms for R3M input
encode_image_to_embedding: encode a preprocessed image tensor into a 2048-dimensional embedding using the R3M model
move_r3m_to_device: move the R3M model to CUDA or CPU device and set it to evaluation mode
